You also meet the following:- 18+ years old-  Good command of English or Dutch- At least 3 days a week- Available for afternoon/evening (14:00 – 22:30) or night shifts (22:30 – 07:00)- Living within 50 km of Oirschot with your own reliable transportWhat will you doAs a warehouse employee at DPD Oirschot you’ll be running through the big warehouse. In this warehouse you are going to load and unload the trucks! Also you need to sort packages by hand. For this you need to be strong. The packages can be heavy! But, you can see it as a free workout! We have two shifts to make some good hours; the afternoon and nighttimes:- 14:00 - 22:30- 22:30 - 07:00Where will you workIn the warehouse of DPD Oirschot! In this warehouse you’ll be joining a team of international warehouse employees. Daily they make sure all the packages get sorted on time. As an assembly worker, you work full-time (38 hours a week) in Eindhoven assembling wire and cable harnesses. You receive clear instructions and will learn to work with various machines and tools. This position offers plenty of opportunities to develop yourself, grow, and learn new technical skills. You work in an informal environment where teamwork is key. The job is for the long term, so you can really build your future here.You start your working day by reviewing the schedule and assembly instructions so you know exactly what needs to be done. Then you get to work assembling cables, soldering components, and performing intermediate quality checks. You use hand tools and measuring equipment to make sure everything is correct. Throughout the day, you work together with colleagues and consult if something is unclear. At the end of the day, you test the cables and make sure everything is finished properly.Do you see yourself working as an assembly worker in a friendly, informal atmosphere where you can really grow? Apply now and discover what this job has to offer you!- You speak english- You can read technical drawings- You work result-oriented, accurately and independently- You are a real team player- Experience with cable assembly is a plus
